card.name: Some, each, other, such as quantifiers
card.fires_on: Quantifier words like "some", "each", "other" and "such" that start a new clause or noun phrase right after a complete phrase, often with no comma before them.

modes.label: Some after a phrase
modes.description: The word "some" follows a finished phrase and introduces a number of hours, patients or items.

modes.description: Other quantifiers such as "each", "such" or "other" appear after a dash, a colon or a drug class.
